title: Standing grant: the batch runner may push a plain merge of main into a handed-in PR branch
why: Owner 13:12 CST Nov 13 answered "a" to the coordinator's standing-grant question (relayed by the coordinator).
source: owner 13:12 CST Nov 13, relayed by the coordinator
note: Doing. The batch runner may push a plain merge of main into a handed-in PR branch when no lane has pushed there in 2 h. No rebase and no force push. A conflict that changes behaviour goes back to the coordinator. Each new head gets a fix check and a fresh record.
